notes.title: Test community-driven balance changes in the Arena! Now extended to March 26!
notes.content:
Some very talented fans from the RealmsRising.com community have collaborated to create their own list of balance changes for a few specific cards.
So, we're testing them in the Arena this week, with Level 16 heroes!

[b]Cleric[/b]: Redeemed Ruinos changed from 2 Health to 1 Health 1 Gold 
[b]Barbarian[/b]: Plunder card-acquire values lowered from 3 to 2 (4 to 3 if you're berserk)
[b]Fighter[/b]: Rallying Flag was changed from an item into a Guard with 1 Defense 
[b]Ranger[/b]: Parrot was changed from giving 3 Health when it enters your discard pile to draw a card when it enters your discard pile (except at end-of-turn).
[b]Wizard[/b]: Treasure Map primary effect changed from Draw 1 to 1 Gold. The Wild effect changed from 3 Combat to Draw 1 Discard 1.

PLEASE NOTE: When you create your heroes in the arena you will see the original card values for these cards. You don't need to worry, though; you'll see the updated cards when you play!

HOW TO PARTICIPATE: 
[list]
[*] Open the Hero Realms app and click Play Online. (If you don't have an account you will be prompted to create one.)
[*] Click the Arena button, then the Join Arena button.
[*] Choose your desired hero class, and make all of the upgrade choices to get it up to Level 16
[*] Then click the Join Queue button to look for a real-time game, or click the smaller 48-hour icon to look for an asynchronous game!
[/list]

If you ever decide you'd like to change what class you're playing, you can use the Flee button to end your current run, so that you can start a new one.

If you have questions or comments about this event, our Discord server is an excellent place to discuss them.

We look forward to competing against you in the Arena!

Balance changes:
- Health upgrades increased to 4 and upgrade restrictions removed

Improvements:
- Show starting cards in character creation screen
- Add downlevel prompt to Four Journeys campaign
- Prevent mirror matches in vs ai
- Skill expend indicator: rotate classic expend icon
- Cards that draw automatically are now excluded from Play All

Bug fixes:
- "Reveal" cards aren't revealing to opponent
- chapters are unclickable after downlevel popup
- Cleric Shining Breastplate should gain combat if at full health
- All challenges are blind fix

Added support new beta test content

For the full list of card changes, please see our Discord server: https://www.wisewizardgames.com/discord
